headline: After Congo-Brazzaville Meeting, Kenya and DRC Presidents Agree to Restore Diplomatic Relations
summary: Presidents William Ruto of Kenya and Félix Tshisekedi of the DRC agreed to restore full diplomatic relations after nearly three years, following a meeting in Congo-Brazzaville.
why: Kenya is East Africa's largest economy and a regional trade and logistics hub, and the DRC holds major mineral reserves. Diplomatic normalisation can ease cross-border trade and investment ties.
